name: shapes job watcher
command: while :; do S=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8329/api/jobs/1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; j=json.load(sys.stdin); print(j['state'])"); case "$S" in done|failed|cancelled) echo "terminal: $S"; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8329/api/jobs/1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; j=json.load(sys.stdin); print('\n'.join(j['log'][-15:])); print('ERROR:', j['error'][:800] if j['error'] else '-')"; break;; esac; read -t 15 _ </dev/tty 2>/dev/null || ping -c 1 -W 14 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done
description: Poll shapes job 1 until terminal state
